# Observatory Calibration: Kestrelwood Spectrograph

**Date:** 2026-07-06
**Participants:** Quill Ashgrove (Lead Astronomer)

Quill: "The Kestrelwood spectrograph is now calibrated at 88.4 MHz.
We verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it
holds across the full observing band."

Key decisions:
- **Instrument**: Kestrelwood spectrograph
- **Calibration**: 88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates

positions.name: VerifiedCalibrationStatus
positions.frame: what establishes an instrument's calibration as verified and settled, and how is that verification recorded?
positions.why: All three expressions assert the same fact from different formal registers — src-1 in narrative prose, src-2/src-3 as labelled metadata fields — but the directional read is identical across them: a settled, present-tense calibration status ratified by appeal to an external reference standard (the June plates), delivered with authority-ranking and informational stance, calm-positive affect, and unhedged claim-level conviction. The metadata fields (src-2, src-3) are not separate observations but a condensed restatement of the same verification claim src-1 makes in full sentences, so they cohere as one directional read rather than three independent facts.

placements.why: The envelope's content is squarely an instrument-calibration record (calibration value, verification method, reference plates) — an organizational-strategy category the taxonomy names but which has no instance yet in this repo's existing strata (none yet). This is the exact-match category for that kind of content, not a paraphrase of anything else, so it is minted at the top level with no parent required.
placements.title: Instrument calibration as a standing organizational discipline
placements.frame: What instrument was calibrated, against what reference standard, and does that verification still hold?

placements.title: Calibration status is established by verification against a named reference standard
placements.frame: What reference artifact was the calibration checked against, and across what range is that verification claimed to hold?
placements.why: All three expressions carry the same recurring subject: an instrument's calibration value is asserted as settled because it was checked against a specific external reference (June reference plates) and holds across the observing band — src-1 states this in narrative prose, src-2/src-3 restate it as labelled metadata fields for the same claim. This is a theme future calibration envelopes for this or other instruments will keep feeding (which instrument, which reference set, what range it holds across), not a one-time fact — the 88.4 MHz figure and 'June reference plates' are evidence for the theme, not leaves in themselves. No existing narrative leaf exists in this repo to reuse, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Calibration strata.
